eyebrow: A deployment is code, not a command
caption: Reviewable and versioned — not a one-off cast send from memory.

code:
forge script script/Deploy.s.sol
# ^ simulates only — no transaction sent

forge script script/Deploy.s.sol \
  --broadcast --rpc-url $RPC_URL --account deployer
caption: --account uses an encrypted keystore key, not a raw --private-key flag.

eyebrow: Named endpoints, and a real gotcha
caption: Mixing up --chain and --rpc-url is how a script hits the wrong network.
